note: Hackathon mock policy. Replace with organiser-provided or team-defined policy rules.

principles: Compare expected and actual route evidence.
Consider legitimate traffic, safety or road-closure reasons.
Avoid ruling solely from rider or driver narrative.

rules.RD-1: A route up to 15% longer than expected is within normal tolerance; no refund is due.
rules.RD-2: A longer route that did not take longer than expected is consistent with avoiding congestion; no refund is due.
rules.RD-3: A route more than 15% longer than expected that also took longer is treated as an unjustified detour; the fare above the expected fare is refunded.
rules.RD-4: If expected and actual distance are not both available, the dispute is escalated to human review.

principles: Check driver proximity to pickup point.
Check waiting time and communication attempts.

rules.NS-1: A no-show fee applies only if the driver arrived within 100 m of the pickup point.
rules.NS-2: A no-show fee applies only if the driver waited at least 5 minutes after arriving.
rules.NS-3: A no-show fee applies only if the driver tried to contact the rider through in-app chat.
rules.NS-4: If the driver's arrival location or waiting time is missing, the dispute is escalated to human review.

rules.SAFE-1: Any threatening message in the chat log is escalated to human review, whatever the fare outcome.

rules.ESC-1: Any ruling with confidence below 60% is escalated to a human reviewer.

rules.FRAUD-1: If either party shows a high bad-faith risk, the dispute is escalated to human review.

rules.REF-1: A refund never exceeds the fare actually charged; a larger computed refund is reduced to the charged fare.

triage.note: Internal only: orders escalated disputes for human reviewers. Never shown to the rider or driver. Weights are team placeholders, like the other thresholds.

tiers.safety: A threat in chat (SAFE-1). Always reviewed first, whatever the score.
tiers.standard: Missing evidence (RD-4, NS-4) or low confidence (ESC-1).
tiers.low: Missing evidence or low confidence, with a proposed refund below low_value_max.
